workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars for the 30-minute partners' meeting next week. Here are the times they are both free:

*   Mon, Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue, Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed, Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu, Nov 19: 10:00, 14:30
*   Fri, Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Could you please check these slots against Elena's and David's calendars? Let me know which ones work for them. Thanks!

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. Of the times you suggested, the only one that works for them is Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. Please go ahead and book the 30-minute meeting for that time. I'll send the confirmation email once it's booked. Thanks!

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, thanks Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. It's ready for you to send the confirmation email.

emails.body: Hi team, this is to confirm the partners' meeting, which is now booked. Talk to you then.
